text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes! Try throwing it with all your 
might!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh...! S-So heavy... The shock went 
all the way through my wrists.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu. It seems to have grown even 
bigger since you came to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Nice pitching, you two! Though I'm sure 
you can throw even harder next time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina spent a fulfilling day off and 
seems to have fully recharged her energy!
